author: Vate_Ozaki
quote: Grand Theft Auto VI ultimately collapses under the weight of its own bloated ambitions, trading the franchise's signature subversive edge for an uninspired, melodramatic narrative that reads less like a gripping crime saga and more like a tedious domestic-management simulator. Rather than delivering the sharp satirical bite or emergent sandbox freedom expected **** flagship, the experience bogged down in mundane relationship micromanagement that actively stifles momentum. Compounded by a frustratingly anti-consumer, digital-only distribution model that denies players tangible ownership via a physical disc, this installment feels like a hollow, over-engineered spectacle stripped of both narrative soul and collector value. Final fantasy 15 was 100 times better and higher graphics.
